messages:
maya: Quick sync on continuous-batching rollout. I sketched three paths: sidecar adapter, in-place swap, split-router hybrid. Short pros/cons + minimal test plan below.

devin: quick bullets pls.

maya: sidecar adapter: + incremental, per-node toggle, low routing change; - extra hop, CPU/mem overhead, kvcache hinting needed.

maya: in-place swap: + best hot-path perf, single codepath; - big blast radius, needs coordinated routing & rollback plan.

maya: split-router hybrid: + fine-grained routing, cost-aware; - two admission surfaces to reconcile, more complexity.

sasha: KV cache: we must pass a compact pin_hint token signed by scheduler. No external API change.

jen: test checklist (min): unit handshake, kvcache sim warm/cold, chaos (kill coalescer mid-batch), 24-48h long-tail perf, canary ramp 1 node->5%->25%->100% with rollback thresholds.

alex: metrics: p50/p95/p99 by path, enqueue->dispatch histo, kvcache hit/miss by path, batch packing efficiency, fallback rate, per-tenant cost delta.

devin: owners: I’ll run canary ops, Sasha owns kvcache tests, Jen owns security/KMS token signing, Alex does cost model. Maya will author design PR with proto sketch.

infra-bot: scheduled-canary: 2026-08-12T02:00:00Z pool batch-canary-01 (dry-run)

maya: Thanks all, PR incoming. :rocket:
